import Mathlib

open Polynomial

/--
Let $f(x) \in \mathbb{Q}[x]$ be a polynomial of degree $n$ ($n>4$) and the splitting field $E$
of $f(x)$ has Galois group $S_n$ over $\mathbb{Q}$. Let $\alpha$ be a zero of $f(x)$ in $E$.
Prove that for any other root $\beta$ of $f(x)$, there are precisely $(n-1)!$ elements in
$\mathrm{Gal}(E/\mathbb{Q})$ that takes $\alpha $ to $\beta$
-/
theorem card_gal_map_eq_eq_factorial {n : Nat} (hn : n > 4) (f : ℚ[X]) (hf : f.degree = n)
    (hf' : Irreducible f) (h : f.Gal ≃* (Equiv.Perm <| Fin n))
    {a b : SplittingField f} (ha : f.aeval a = 0) (hb : f.aeval b = 0) (neq : a ≠ b) :
    Nat.card {h : f.Gal // h a = b} = Nat.factorial (n - 1) := by
  sorry

theorem card_gal_map_eq_eq_factorial {n : Nat} (hn : n > 4) (f : ℚ[X]) (hf : f.degree = n)
    (hf' : Irreducible f) (h : f.Gal ≃* (Equiv.Perm <| Fin n))
    {a b : SplittingField f} (ha : f.aeval a = 0) (hb : f.aeval b = 0) (neq : a ≠ b) :
    Nat.card {h : f.Gal // h a = b} = Nat.factorial (n - 1) := by
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    simp [h0] at hf
  have hsplit : Fact ((map (algebraMap ℚ f.SplittingField) f).Splits) := ⟨SplittingField.splits f⟩
  haveI : MulAction.IsPretransitive f.Gal (f.rootSet f.SplittingField) :=
    Polynomial.Gal.galAction_isPretransitive f _ hf'
  have hcardR : Nat.card (f.rootSet f.SplittingField) = n := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, card_rootSet_eq_natDegree hf'.separable (SplittingField.splits f),
      natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some hf]
  have hG : Nat.card f.Gal = n.factorial := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr h.toEquiv, Nat.card_perm, Nat.card_fin]
  have ha' : a ∈ f.rootSet f.SplittingField := mem_rootSet.2 ⟨hf0, ha⟩
  have hb' : b ∈ f.rootSet f.SplittingField := mem_rootSet.2 ⟨hf0, hb⟩
  set x : f.rootSet f.SplittingField := ⟨a, ha'⟩ with hx
  set y : f.rootSet f.SplittingField := ⟨b, hb'⟩ with hy
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq f.Gal x y
  -- fiber equals stabilizer
  have hfiber : Nat.card {g : f.Gal // g a = b} = Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer f.Gal x) := by
    refine Nat.card_congr ((Equiv.subtypeEquiv (Equiv.mulLeft c⁻¹) ?_))
    intro g
    have key : ∀ g : f.Gal, g a = b ↔ g • x = y := by
      intro g
      constructor
      · intro hg
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hg
      · intro hg
        have := congrArg Subtype.val hg
        exact this
    sorry
  sorry

    refine Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquiv (Equiv.mulLeft c⁻¹) ?_)
    intro g
    rw [key, MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hg
      show (c⁻¹ * g) • x = x
      rw [mul_smul, hg, ← hc, inv_smul_smul]
    · intro hs
      have hs' : (c⁻¹ * g) • x = x := hs
      have e : g • x = c • ((c⁻¹ * g) • x) := by
        rw [mul_smul, smul_inv_smul]
      rw [e, hs']

    rw [MulAction.index_stabilizer, MulAction.orbit_eq_univ, Set.ncard_univ, hcardR]
